title: Python FastAPI streaming data system
spec: Build a Python 3.12+ FastAPI telemetry service using only a local filesystem data store. Include deterministic generation of 750,000 CSV records, streaming ingestion, bounded multiprocessing aggregation, malformed-row quarantine, pytest unit and integration tests, and an HTTP API. Keep dependencies in pyproject.toml and provide repeatable CLI commands.
prompts: Create the package, typed domain model, configuration, CLI skeleton, and focused unit tests. Create one project-local .venv and install the declared runtime and test dependencies into it once; use that environment for every Python command.
Implement deterministic generation and streaming ingestion for 750,000 records split across 12 files without loading the complete dataset into memory.
Add bounded multiprocessing aggregation, malformed-row quarantine, deterministic output, and tests comparing one-worker and multi-worker results.
Implement the FastAPI endpoints, pagination and aggregate filters. Add API integration tests without leaving a server running.
Run the full test suite, compile check, data pipeline, and a measured benchmark. Fix failures and record correctness and throughput in BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md.
